radiusSource: Radius 1.39 +/- 0.02 solar radii and temperature 2600 +/- 20 K: the SPHINX model-atmosphere fit to the pair's blended optical spectrum, modelled as the sum of the two stars by Inglis et al. (2024, AJ; doi:10.3847/1538-3881/ad2771; arXiv:2402.09533), Table 1 (their text gives 1.59 solar radii for this star; the table is used). A model radius: the disc is not measured. 967,023 km. GM from the photometric mass 0.36 +/- 0.04 solar masses of Kraus et al. (2014, ApJ 781, 20; arXiv:1311.7664) times the JPL solar GM.
orbitalPeriodSource: Inglis et al. (2026, AJ 171, 280; doi:10.3847/1538-3881/ae4b34), Table 2: the orbitize! MCMC fit to Keck NIRC speckle, SPHERE and NIRC2 relative astrometry of B around A, 2001-2022; posterior medians. P = 31 +3/-2 yr of 365.25 d.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published model radius. ROXs 42B B's disc is not resolved and no image of it exists; its colour is a blackbody at the published temperature, 2,600 K.

effectiveTemperatureSource: 2600 +/- 20 K: the SPHINX model fit of Inglis et al. (2024, AJ), Table 1, https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.09533
